summary: v9.2.0 Master All-in-One Trading Engine verified. Backend 8/8 PASSED: VWAP engine routing correct (scalper→SCALPER, day→INTRADAY, swing→SWING) on BTC 1h chart with all new indicator fields present (vwap float, price_dev_pct float, box_high/box_low floats, john_wick bool, power_of_tower bool); HOLD emits entry/stop_loss/take_profit all null, BUY/SELL all non-null; profile=longterm correctly has NO vwap_engine (Confluence v9.0 path preserved); dashboard/batch vs chart SYNC identical for action/label/confidence on BTC/ETH/SOL with profile=day; regressions clean (search q=TSLA → TSLA stock_us hit #1 at 380.12, /api/dashboard?market=stock_id returns assets, BBCA chart → INTRADAY engine with sane levels within ±20% of price). Frontend smoke PASSED: dashboard loads past disclaimer gate, header shows 'Ver 9.2.0', signal cards render (LONG/SELL/HOLD + AI confidence), no error elements, API reachable from page context (200). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) found.

minor.issue: Forex chart returned 404 with profile=scalper during manual probe (volume-less markets have no VWAP fallback data). Out of scope of this iteration's request but worth confirming intended behavior for volume-less markets on VWAP profiles.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings on web preview: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-breaking; surfaces repeatedly across app. Reference: multiple components.

action_items: Confirm intended behavior for forex/gold/commodity symbols on VWAP profiles (scalper/day/swing) — EURUSD chart returned 404 in manual probe; if VWAP engine should fall back to Confluence when volume data is unavailable, verify fallback path triggers for all volume-less markets.
Minor cleanup: replace deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents props in RN components to silence web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: indicators.py is 1151 lines and server.py is 2892 lines — both exceed the 700-line guideline; consider splitting indicators.py (VWAP engine block lines 414-760 is a natural module boundary).
VWAP engine schema is additive only (vwap_engine, john_wick*, power_of_tower*, box_* added to indicators) — no removals, backward compatible with v9.0.0 dashboard consumers as claimed.
HOLD levels correctly null in VWAP engine; _compute_vwap_levels gate consistent with Confluence behavior.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only API tests, no test data created.

rca_of_issue: Only failure during the run was a test-side parsing bug (search response uses 'hits' key, test expected 'results'); fixed the test, not the app. App-side search verified correct: q=TSLA returns TSLA stock_us as first hit with price 380.12 plus 5 disambiguation entries.
